landmark_ordinances.title: Comprehensive Anti-Smoking Ordinance
landmark_ordinances.description: Prohibits smoking, e-cigarettes, and shisha in all public places. Fines range from ₱3,000 to ₱5,000.

landmark_ordinances.title: Liquor Ban Ordinance
landmark_ordinances.description: Prohibits the sale of liquor and alcoholic beverages from 1:00 AM to 8:00 AM daily. Consumption in public places is banned 24/7.

landmark_ordinances.title: Speed Limit Ordinance
landmark_ordinances.description: Strict speed limits (80 kph, 60 kph, 40 kph, 30 kph, 20 kph) based on road type to improve safety. Enforced by CTTMO with fines up to ₱5,000.

recent_ordinances_and_resolutions.title: Adoption of Updated Geohazard Maps
recent_ordinances_and_resolutions.description: Adopted the updated 2026 Flood and Rain-induced Landslide Susceptibility Maps.

recent_ordinances_and_resolutions.title: Waste-to-Energy Project Funding
recent_ordinances_and_resolutions.description: Approved ₱685.3M budget including ₱65M reserve fund for an 11-MW waste-to-energy plant bid.

recent_ordinances_and_resolutions.title: School-Based Feeding Program
recent_ordinances_and_resolutions.description: Agreement with DepEd for a school-based feeding program.

recent_ordinances_and_resolutions.title: PWD Financial Assistance
recent_ordinances_and_resolutions.description: Promulgated implementing rules for City Ord. No. 049-25 granting annual financial assistance to PWDs.
